readme:
# Google Keywords for Categories API

Get Google keywords that belong to the product and service categories you pass, with search volume, CPC and competition.

## Request

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.sandbase.ai/v1/api/dataforseo/v3/dataforseo_labs/google/keywords_for_categories/live" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SANDBASE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"category_codes": [13418], "location_code": 2840, "language_code": "en", "limit": 10}'
```

## Parameters

The body is passed through to DataForSEO. See the [official documentation](https://docs.dataforseo.com/v3/dataforseo_labs/google/keywords_for_categories/live/) for every field.

## Pricing

Billed at the actual cost of each call, about $0.0132 for the request above. The cost grows with the number of rows, targets or pages a call returns. One task per request; `limit` is capped at 100 and input lists (`keywords`, `targets`, `asins`, `app_ids` ...) accept at most 100 items. Failed calls are not charged. Searches with no results are billed at their actual cost.
